info.about: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 is a 2014 action-adventure video game based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man and the 2014 film of the same name. Developed by Beenox, it is the sequel to 2012's The Amazing Spider-Man, itself based on the 2012 film of the same name. and takes place within the same continuity, different from that of the films.
info.trivia: Beenox originally planned to make the 3DS version as well, but it was handed to High Voltage Software instead.
info.why: Its digital version was delisted on January 4, 2017 across PlayStation and every other platform, alongside the first game.
